exposure.needed: which Kafka clusters in the environment are ZooKeeper-based (the evidence names no CRD field, version or key that identifies a ZooKeeper-based cluster)

assertion.statement: Strimzi 0.46.0 removed support for ZooKeeper-based Apache Kafka clusters and, as part of the same change, for KRaft migration, so ZooKeeper-based Kafka clusters are no longer a supported configuration.

proposal.undeterminedReason: consequence: the changelog states only that support was removed; it does not say whether upgrading a ZooKeeper-based cluster is blocked, fails, or must first be migrated to KRaft
